verdict.rationale: Canny's official MCP server connects ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor to Canny data. Its docs say users can ask their LLM about top feedback themes and ARR impact across ideas, which matches the story directly. Missing for 10: detailed tool-level documentation of the theme and ARR queries, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an AI assistant questions about customer feedback themes and their revenue impact

citations.quote: Ask your LLM what customers asked for and understand the context behind each request. Dig into top themes, ARR impact across ideas, and query your team's roadmap.
Connect Canny to ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor. Ask questions about customer feedback, take action on it, and ground your AI workflows in real customer data.
Add Canny's MCP server to ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor with a secure sign-in.
